content.text: In Zimbabwe, where the local currency, the Zimbabwean dollar, collapsed in 2009, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-7|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s-every-detail-you|digital]] creators face significant challenges in collecting payments for their digital products. Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted, making it difficult for online entrepreneurs to turn their creative ideas into a profitable business. COREMERCH, a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-5|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce infrastructure company, offers a solution to this problem by providing a range of digital commerce stacks that allow creators to build and manage their online stores without relying on these platforms. This guide will focus on setting up a Supabase order database for digital stores using COREMERCH's infrastructure, specifically Stack 01, which can be deployed in just 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The reason why COREMERCH's infrastructure works when platforms fail is that it's built on a foundation of open-source tools and decentralized payment systems. By using GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, creators can build a fully operational online store without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or other restricted platforms. This infrastructure is not a workaround, but a base-layer solution that gives creators full control over their digital commerce stack.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy Stack 01, you'll need to create a GitHub Pages site, set up a Cloudflare Workers account, and install the Supabase order database. You'll also need to have a NOWPayments account and a wallet to receive cryptocurrency payments. Additionally, you should have a digital product ready for sale and a plan for how you'll deliver it to customers. Finally, you should have a basic understanding of how to use the Supabase order database and how to configure payment gateways using Cloudflare Workers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have the necessary tools and accounts set up, you can start configuring your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves setting up a payment gateway using NOWPayments, configuring the payment webhook to trigger automatically when a payment is received, and setting up the delivery pipeline to send digital products to customers. You'll also need to configure the Supabase order database to store customer information and order details.
You can deploy Stack 01 in just 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live, you'll need to deploy Stack 01 and configure the payment and delivery pipeline. You can deploy Stack 01 in just 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. Once deployed, you can test your payment and delivery pipeline to ensure that it's working as expected. When you're ready, you can start processing transactions and selling your digital products to customers. COREMERCH offers a 30-day support package for Stack 01, which includes help with deployment, payment configuration, and delivery pipeline setup.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running, you can start scaling your digital store to meet increasing demand. This involves adding more products, increasing your payment processing capacity, and optimizing your delivery pipeline to ensure that customers receive their digital products quickly and efficiently. You can also use the Supabase order database to analyze customer behavior and preferences, which can help you tailor your marketing and sales strategies to meet their needs.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question you'll want to ask is: 'What is the cost of deploying Stack 01?' The answer is: it's a one-time payment of $97, which includes a 30-day support package and the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides a step-by-step guide to deploying Stack 01. This is a fraction of the cost of using a platform like Stripe or PayPal, and it gives you full control over your digital commerce stack.
The Supabase order database is free to use and offers a range of features and customization options.

If you're looking for a more advanced digital commerce stack that includes features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing, you may want to consider COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, which can be deployed in just 48 hours. You can also visit the COREMERCH website at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about their products and services.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy Stack 01, you'll need to: create a GitHub Pages site, set up a Cloudflare Workers account, install the Supabase order database, and set up a NOWPayments account. You'll also need to configure the payment webhook, set up the delivery pipeline, and configure the Supabase order database to store customer information and order details. Finally, you'll need to deploy Stack 01 and configure the payment and delivery pipeline to go live.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02?

Stack 01 is a basic digital commerce stack that includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for payment verification. Stack 02 is an advanced digital commerce stack that includes features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing, and is deployed by COREMERCH in just 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages using Stack 01 or Stack 02. Both platforms offer free hosting and a range of customization options to help you build and manage your online store.

The cost of deploying Stack 01 is a one-time payment of $97, which includes a 30-day support package and the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides a step-by-step guide to deploying Stack 01.
How do I configure the payment gateway using Cloudflare Workers?

To configure the payment gateway using Cloudflare Workers, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account, configure the payment webhook to trigger automatically when a payment is received, and configure the payment gateway to process transactions.
Can I use the Supabase order database to analyze customer behavior and preferences?
Yes, you can use the Supabase order database to analyze customer behavior and preferences, which can help you tailor your marketing and sales strategies to meet their needs.
You can use the NOWPayments payment gateway to accept a range of cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Binance Coin.
